title: CRISPR observability: claim and evidence graph

nodes.label: Fixed finite record universe
nodes.scope: Every E/NE/U count retains the original N; records are not assumed independent molecules.

nodes.label: One explicit event and observation contract
nodes.scope: Reference, orientation, boundary ownership, quality policy and admissible path set are fixed per comparison.

nodes.label: Accepted labels and free completion
nodes.scope: Identification hulls assume accepted labels correct and permit all binary completions of unresolved records. Error budgets are a separate sensitivity analysis.

nodes.label: Anchor geometry changes a contrast lower endpoint
nodes.scope: CFTR CFB-26-16 under the same Q30 mask: edge lower endpoint -10.09177 pp versus target +13.23196 pp. This is not an identified reversal of a biological treatment effect.
nodes.falsifier: An exact record-level replay under the declared same-mask geometry fails to reproduce the endpoint difference.
nodes.details: 3071/3227 is a conditional anchor-loss diagnostic, not a sensitivity estimate against true biological edits.

nodes.label: Equal event labels do not imply equal strings
nodes.scope: Among 170808 records resolved by three extractors, 83 have unequal coding strings; 18 retain equal event labels.
nodes.falsifier: Record identities, observed strings and the declared extraction operators fail to reproduce the documented counterexamples.
nodes.details: The exact 83-record correspondence ledger is included; the earlier extraction replay is pinned separately.

nodes.label: Finite-record identification preserves abstention
nodes.scope: For N=E+NE+U, all freely completed proportions have hull [E/N,(E+U)/N]; coupled multi-event hulls use per-record feasible sets.
nodes.falsifier: A completion satisfying the stated premises falls outside the proposed hull, or an asserted endpoint has no admissible completion.
nodes.details: These are attainable finite-record bounds, not confidence or credible intervals and not estimated biological error rates.

nodes.label: Complete-path projection and orientation transport
nodes.scope: Bounded independent path enumeration checks projection images, dual boundary ownership and selected target-class score maxima.
nodes.falsifier: A legal enumerated path yields a missing or extra projected image, incorrect score maximum, or failed reverse-complement transport.
nodes.details: Tests cover finite declared alphabets and sizes; they do not establish formal verification of arbitrary implementation states or biological accuracy.

nodes.label: Clone3 sign reconciled with retained sequence evidence
nodes.scope: Retained Clone3 modal span is net -6 against JEB, with equivalent deletion starts 40 and 41. Source Table S2 says +6; Figure 6A supports -6.
nodes.falsifier: Authentic source sequences or an author correction establish the opposite net length or uniquely resolve a coordinate.
nodes.details: Analytical reconciliation, not an erratum issued by the source authors. DNA and cDNA are distinct libraries, not the same molecule.

nodes.label: Nonmodal COL17A1 counts and witnesses reproduce
nodes.scope: Complete retained pair ledgers reproduce strict-admission deficit-36 counts over 439589 pairs; full replay recomputes 20260 reference cases and 81112 attaining witnesses.
nodes.falsifier: Any retained-pair aggregation, target-class deficit or attaining witness fails the frozen counts and hashes.
nodes.details: Replay begins with retained source spans; fresh extraction of all 72 FASTQ files and an independently calibrated truth benchmark are outside this execution.

nodes.label: Larger score deficit is not a biological validity ordering
nodes.scope: Historical HG002 and KEAP1 controls contain concordant calls withdrawn before discordant ones as the admitted score deficit grows.
nodes.falsifier: Recalculation with the frozen references, event labels and score grammar reverses the reported local withdrawal ordering.
nodes.details: Historical evidence and source code are distributed in the separate scientific archive identified by its SHA-256 and release URL. This result was not freshly rerun in this revision and does not establish a universal error rate or software ranking.

nodes.label: Independent exhaustive path oracle
nodes.scope: Generated test strings are software tests, not new biological observations.

nodes.label: Full retained-span replay
nodes.scope: All 18 clone ledgers and strict-versus-available admission policies checked.

nodes.label: Zero-cell serialization mismatch
nodes.scope: A failed equality check compared explicit zero cells with omitted Counter cells; comparison repaired, original zeros and counts preserved.

nodes.label: Biological accuracy and molecular independence
nodes.scope: No new same-molecule orthogonal truth is established for CFTR/HEK3. Independent clone/benchmark controls have their own narrower jurisdiction.

nodes.label: Fresh raw-data and upstream-engine rerun
nodes.scope: This release replays retained spans and frozen outputs. It does not claim a fresh complete upstream engine or 72-file FASTQ extraction.

nodes.label: Independent environment and browser interaction
nodes.scope: Checks executed on the recorded Windows/Python environment. A second OS, fresh environment installation and interactive browser QA were not executed.

nodes.label: Versioned inputs and source baseline
nodes.scope: File hashes bind local payloads; prior CFTR/HEK3 software is pinned to a public repository commit.

semantics: Edges describe logical requirements, evidence checks or scope limits. They are not probabilities, causal estimates or a claim of independent replication. All premises listed on a claim are jointly required.
ui_verification: Static/data checks executed; browser interaction unavailable in this session.
